Supported Networks
@JunctionFi supports over 30 blockchain networks, including: 

Bitcoin (BTC)

Ethereum (ETH)

Solana (SOL)

Dogecoin (DOGE)

Litecoin (LTC)

Bitcoin Cash (BCH)

Cosmos (ATOM)

What is JunctionFi?
@JunctionFi is a decentralized finance  platform designed to simplify cross-chain trading .It enables users to swap assets across multiple blockchain ecosystems including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, Dogecoin, and Cosmos without the need for wrapped tokens.
